about_the_game:
Game Description:

Welcome to Where Time Breaks, a unique blend of tower defense and rogue-like elements set in a world where reality has shattered. In this chaotic realm, the very laws of nature are upended—gravity flips, time speeds up and slows down, and attacks may become absurdly comical. The world is governed by the Absurd Rift, a vast arena where survival is the only rule.

Core Gameplay:
Play as an abstract repairman, a ranged fighter trapped in this distorted world. Use strategy to deploy towers, draw upon the power of cards, and face endless waves of enemies. Each victory grants you coins, which can be spent on card pulls to enhance your abilities, making you stronger as you progress through the increasingly difficult levels.

The Absurd Rift:
The Absurd Rift is ruled by a group of enigmatic Absurd Executors, the embodiments of chaos who govern the battlefield. The only rule in this world is survival amidst the madness. As you advance through the levels, new challenges await, with more towers unlocked and increasingly powerful enemies to face. Adapt to the ever-changing world of the Rift, where nothing stays the same for long.

Battle Features:

  • Auto-Attack System: Your character and towers automatically target the fastest-moving enemy (the nearest to you). This ensures a smooth, dynamic battle experience.

  • Chaotic Rules: Time and gravity can flip at any moment, forcing you to adapt your strategy on the fly.

  • Independent Tower System: Towers have their own cooldowns and operate independently from your character, allowing for more strategic depth.

  • Card Growth System: Pull cards to enhance your abilities, build a personalized strategy, and become stronger after each battle.

Three Distinct Levels:

  • Level One: A simple map to help you get a feel for the mechanics, though still challenging as you begin to understand the absurd laws of the Rift.

  • Level Two: Towers are unlocked, and the enemy waves become more complex, pushing you to think strategically.

  • Level Three: New types of enemies and more intricate map designs require true mastery of the Absurd Rift's chaotic rules to survive.

Ready to face the chaos and defy the impossible? In Where Time Breaks, only those who embrace the madness will conquer the world where time and logic no longer apply.
